faq.answer: Compare equivalent periods and account for room inventory, promotions, seasonality, and cancellations. Track confirmed direct reservations separately from visits, booking-button clicks, and availability questions.

title: E-commerce SEO for Kerala craft brands
summary: Make handmade collections easier to find and buy, from the material and variation a shopper selects to delivery within India or overseas.

faq.answer: Explain verified material, dimensions, care, and natural differences between items. Use your own photographs or images with permission, and distinguish a representative sample from the exact item for sale.
faq.question: How should we describe handmade variations?

faq.answer: Not automatically. If it will return, communicate availability honestly and offer relevant alternatives. For a permanently discontinued item, choose a suitable alternative only when it genuinely serves the same intent.
faq.question: Should a temporarily sold-out piece be redirected?

content.body: For a Kerala handloom or homeware shop, an informative collection is more useful than another generic craft article. Identify whether a visitor is choosing a material, use, size, or gift. Connect that collection to items the shop can actually supply. Keep retail buying guides separate from bulk-order information.

content.heading: Build collections around a buying decision

content.heading: Make provenance useful and verifiable

content.body: For variations of one item, explain what changes and which version is available. Distinguish a temporary stockout from a permanently retired product. Check the links and alternatives in either case, rather than sending every unavailable product to the homepage. Only state dispatch times and destinations the business can support.
content.heading: Protect useful pages when stock changes

content.body: Test a mobile shopper’s path from collection to product to checkout. With the owner’s authorised shop data, separate discovery, completed orders, returns, and wholesale requests. If the shop cannot deliver to a visitor’s country, measuring that visit as a sales opportunity will overstate the value of the traffic.
